# ClockOn Workforce Management

> ClockOn is an Australian workforce management and payroll platform that brings rostering, time and attendance, award interpretation, HR records, payroll, superannuation and STP reporting into one connected system. Optional outsourced payroll support is available for businesses that want payroll handled by ClockOn specialists.

ClockOn is built for Australian businesses that need to manage shift-based teams, Modern Award compliance, payroll accuracy and workforce administration across one or more locations. It is commonly used by businesses with 5–500 staff, including pharmacy, medical, retail, hospitality, trades, logistics, childcare, manufacturing, clubs, pubs and other award-covered industries.
